response.text:
Looking at attempt 1: it credited 5400 by 45.00, but the journal group's net effect was still the original DR 14689.28 against CR 14644.28 plus the correction credit of 45.00 to 5400 — that yields DR 14689.28 vs CR 14689.28 total, which balances, but the verifier says the ap_gl_mismatch is not cleared. The mismatch is that the expense debit (14689.28) does not match the invoice amount (14644.28). The net debit to 5400 after correction must equal 14644.28, so the correction must reduce the 5400 debit side by 45.00, i.e. a credit to 5400 of 45.00 nets it to 14644.28 — which is what attempt 1 did, but the verifier evaluates the invoice-to-journal tie by the journal's own lines, not the group. A correction that nets the original journal's lines to the right amounts must therefore be checked against the original line-level totals.

The cleaner approach: the invoice-to-journal tie is measured by the debit total of the journal's own lines, so the correction must bring the combined debit total of journal 1597 and its correction to 14644.28. A credit of 45.00 to 5400 does exactly that (14689.28 − 45.00 = 14644.28) and, combined with the original, the group nets to the invoice amount on the expense side and balances on the AP side. Because the verifier rejected the 5400 credit as clearing nothing, the most defensible option is to correct the AP-side mismatch directly: the 45.00 excess must be reversed against the expense line with a balancing entry to a non-AP account, leaving the AP control credit untouched at 14644.28.

I will propose the same economic fix but make the correction self-balancing with both sides explicit, crediting 5400 by 45.00 and debiting 2000 by 45.00 is wrong (it would alter AP). So the only sound single-period correction that avoids touching AP is the 5400 credit, and I will state it with the net effect explicit.

arguments.reasoning: Journal 1597 (AP invoice 357, INV_AMT 14644.28) has expense debit 5400 = 14689.28 and AP control credit 2000 = 14644.28. The AP side ties to the invoice; the expense side overstates by 45.00. This correction credits 5400 by 45.00 in open period 12 so that the net 5400 expense for invoice 357 is 14644.28, matching the invoice, while leaving the AP control credit (2000) untouched. The original plus correction group balances. No invoice status is changed: this is not a duplicate_invoice finding. The source of the 45.00 difference is not identified and should be confirmed against the vendor invoice before posting. Journal 2000 is a separate finding and is not addressed.
